name: b4xpp
description: VS Code extension for B4X++ v0.6.0: BANano MVP, native B4X tooling, web syntax support and chained initializer IntelliSense.

commands.title: Set Current File Language to B4X

b4xpp.outputDir.description: Output folder for generated classic B4X files (.bas).

b4xpp.mainModuleName.description: Main module name when no #MainModule directive is found. Leave empty to avoid generating an implicit main module.

b4xpp.addGeneratedHeader.description: Add an AUTO-GENERATED header to generated .bas files.

b4xpp.includeTimestamp.description: Add a generation timestamp to the header. Disabled by default to avoid noisy diffs.

b4xpp.projectDir.description: Output folder for generated B4A/B4J/B4i projects.

b4xpp.packageName.description: Package / application id used in generated B4X project files.

b4xpp.mobileMainModuleName.description: Code module name used to host the B4X++ #MainModule in B4A/B4i projects, avoiding conflicts with the native Main module.

b4xpp.b4xpplibDir.description: Output folder for generated .b4xpplib source packages.

b4xpp.b4jBuildCommand.description: Optional custom B4J build shell command. If empty, B4X++ uses B4JBuilder.exe. Placeholders: {project}, {workspace}, {projectDir}, {configuration}, {task}. Example: "C:/Program Files/Anywhere Software/B4J/B4JBuilder.exe" -Task=Build -Project={project} -BaseFolder={projectDir} -ShowWarnings=True

b4xpp.b4aBuildCommand.description: Optional custom B4A build shell command. If empty, B4X++ uses B4ABuilder.exe when found. Placeholders: {project}, {workspace}, {projectDir}, {configuration}, {task}.

b4xpp.b4iBuildCommand.description: Optional custom B4i build shell command. B4X++ does not assume an official B4i CLI; this command is used as-is and its output is remapped. Placeholders: {project}, {workspace}, {projectDir}, {configuration}, {task}.

b4xpp.b4j.builderPath.description: Path to B4JBuilder.exe. If empty, B4X++ tries C:\Program Files\Anywhere Software\B4J\B4JBuilder.exe and Program Files (x86).

b4xpp.b4a.builderPath.description: Path to B4ABuilder.exe. If empty, B4X++ tries common B4A / Basic4android install folders.

b4xpp.b4i.builderPath.description: Optional path to a custom B4i command-line builder. Usually prefer b4xpp.b4iBuildCommand because B4i uses a Mac builder workflow.

b4xpp.buildConfiguration.description: B4X build configuration passed as -Configuration=... to B4JBuilder.exe / B4ABuilder.exe.

b4xpp.buildTask.description: B4X builder task passed as -Task=... . Default is Build.

b4xpp.buildUseBaseFolder.description: Pass -BaseFolder=<project folder> to B4JBuilder.exe / B4ABuilder.exe. Disable if your builder version has issues with BaseFolder.

b4xpp.writeLineSourceMap.description: Write best-effort generated-line to .bx source mappings in .b4xpp/sourceMap.json. Used for compiler/runtime error remapping.

b4xpp.enableSemanticDiagnostics.description: Enable B4X++ workspace semantic diagnostics for types, member access, #Include, Extends and CustomView color-property mistakes.

b4xpp.validation.strict.description: Enable stricter B4X++ validation: unknown identifiers and obvious semantic issues become errors before generating / building in B4X.

b4xpp.platform.description: Target platform used for library metadata indexing (.xml and .b4xlib) when no #Project directive is available.

b4xpp.b4j.internalLibraryDirs.description: B4J internal library folders containing .xml files and .b4xlib and .b4xpplib packages.

b4xpp.b4j.additionalLibraryDirs.description: B4J additional library folders containing .xml files and .b4xlib and .b4xpplib packages.

b4xpp.b4a.internalLibraryDirs.description: B4A internal library folders containing .xml files and .b4xlib and .b4xpplib packages.

b4xpp.b4a.additionalLibraryDirs.description: B4A additional library folders containing .xml files and .b4xlib and .b4xpplib packages.

b4xpp.b4i.internalLibraryDirs.description: B4i internal library folders containing .xml files and .b4xlib and .b4xpplib packages.

b4xpp.b4i.additionalLibraryDirs.description: B4i additional library folders containing .xml files and .b4xlib and .b4xpplib packages.

b4xpp.bananoServer.port.description: Port used by the integrated local HTTP server for generated BANano output. If busy, B4X++ tries the next ports.

b4xpp.bananoServer.openBrowser.description: Open the browser automatically after B4X++ starts the integrated BANano output server.

b4xpp.banano.runJarAfterBuild.description: For #Project BANano, run the generated Objects/<ProjectName>.jar after a successful B4JBuilder build so BANano produces index.html / JavaScript.

b4xpp.banano.promptServeAfterRun.description: After the BANano generator jar completes, ask whether to serve the generated index.html with the integrated local HTTP server.

b4xpp.banano.javaPath.description: Optional path to java/java.exe used to run the generated BANano jar. If empty, B4X++ tries JAVA_HOME and then java from PATH.

b4xpp.banano.javaFxLibPath.description: Optional JavaFX lib folder used to run BANano generator jars, for example C:\b4j\java\javafx\lib. If empty, B4X++ tries to infer it from javaPath / B4J install paths.
